prompts.name: Field Guide
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: StackOS public website workflow-detail design concept. Create realistic, production-quality UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. Target dimensions: 1440 x 1024 desktop viewport; full-bleed website canvas, straight-on, no browser chrome/device frame. A focused primary screen for someone deciding how to refresh an existing page with their AI assistant. One primary action: "Copy example request"; supporting text links only. This is a public informational page, not a workflow-execution app.
Attached reference 1 is the CURRENT page to redesign, supplied for actual content and brand grounding; substantially improve its layout, do not copy its oversized dark hero/diagram. Attached reference 2 is the actual StackOS stone icon; retain it small and recognizable in navigation.
Brand: near-black #090b10, warm paper #f3f1ea, lime #d9ff63, cobalt #3153d6. Keep logo and recognizable palette but emphasize hierarchy over decoration. Max 2 fonts, Manrope for UI/body; body 16px, comfortable paragraph width about 65 characters. Use whitespace, alignment and thin separators first; tints second, borders sparingly, no nested cards, no repeated cards for normal lists, no ornamental diagrams, no gradients/glows or floating windows.
Canonical product boundary: users set goals, agents plan and reason; StackOS stores scoped work, connects tools and preserves records. Do not suggest StackOS makes strategic decisions. No fabricated charts, rankings, testimonials, live runs, success receipts, metrics, customer logos, new provider features or launch/run controls. This is a static design proposal, not evidence of a performed workflow. Current date anchor is October 5, 2026, but omit dates.
Reuse this exact approved copy:
Title "SEO Content Refresh"
Summary "A reviewed page-edit plan, verified changes when authorized, or a later performance check. Each change keeps its source, review and verification record."
Example request heading "Start with a request"
Example request text "Use SEO Content Refresh on [page URLs]. Readers should be able to try each method. Keep the URLs and useful links. Show the proposed edits and checks before changing the site."
Input bullets "Existing page URLs and the reader or business problem to solve"; "Current page content and available search or analytics evidence, from connected tools or approved exports".
Output heading "What you get"; output sentence "A reviewed proposal with the exact old and new wording, the reason for each edit, useful links to preserve and the checks to run."
Secondary link "View all stages"
Further content can continue naturally below the viewport; do not cram all reference details into this frame. All rendered text legible, correctly spelled. No concept title banner or option number.
DIRECTION: Field Guide. Warm paper dominant, quiet precise documentation with generous air. A 64px pale header with logo at x60, small navigation "Workflows", "Library", "Get started" and an understated "Download for Mac" link. Content max width 1280 centered. Small breadcrumb above the main content. Narrow left contents rail, about 190px wide, starting around y190, with "Overview", "Start with a request", "What you need", "What you get", "Stages", "Reviews and recovery". An active blue rule at the request entry. Main article column begins x340 with small uppercase "SEO / WORKFLOW", 52px near-black title aligned to the reading column, compact summary, ample breathing room. Place the request at about y390 in one pale white grouped surface, blue small primary copy button at upper right of its heading. Quote uses dark text 19px with generous leading; avoid terminal styling. Below it, the input list and expected output are clearly separated by typography and a simple rule, visually align as two columns if comfortable. An understated small "9 stages · 3 specialist agents" metadata line near bottom and View all stages link. Warm, approachable, helpful like a beautifully designed technical field guide; functional density, restrained cobalt links and tiny lime marker. No dark hero block.
